scripts.check: biome check . && oxlint --type-aware && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.verify: biome check --diagnostic-level=warn . && oxlint --type-aware --quiet && uv run ruff check -q && uv run ruff format --check -q && turbo run typecheck test --output-logs=errors-only && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && python3 scripts/guard_old_word.py && python3 scripts/guard_file_length.py && node scripts/draft-calls.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run ruff format
scripts.api:generate: uv run --package parfocal-api python -m parfocal_api.openapi && pnpm --filter @parfocal/api-client generate
scripts.images:lock: uv run --package parfocal-deploy python -m parfocal_deploy.image_locks write
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package parfocal-api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.test:db: docker compose up -d --wait && uv run pytest -m db
scripts.load: PYTHONPATH=scripts uv run --group load locust -f scripts/load/locustfile.py
scripts.load:run: PYTHONPATH=scripts uv run --group load python scripts/load/run.py
scripts.load:token: PYTHONPATH=scripts uv run --package parfocal-api --env-file .env python scripts/load/local_token.py
